reviews.title: Surprisingly Good Quality for the Price
reviews.body: I bought this to make a moss pole for my philodendron so it can climb the way it would in the wild. Pre‑made moss poles were overpriced, and most coco fiber rolls cost just as much—except this one. I’m not sure why the price is lower, but the quality is solid.The material is easy to work with. I rolled it on itself a couple of times to loosen it up, then used a craft glue gun to attach it to a PVC pipe. The photo shows my finished pole. The plant is tied for now, but once its aerial roots reach into this fiber, it’s going to be very happy.Overall, great value and exactly what I needed for a DIY pole.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 26, 2026

features: The thick coco fiber roll is made of 100% natural coconut coir fibers, eco-friendly, healthy.
It's size: 12x40 inch/30x100cm. The coco fiber sheet is packed in a roll.

You can use it as coconut fiber planter liner, hanging basket liner, flower planter basket liner, window box liner, square fibers coir liner, pet pad, weed mat, tree root protect mat, chicken cage mat, snow mat, ground cover, garden decoration.

The coir fabric liner is thickness and sturdy, great for home plants and pets, reptile carpet, tortoise carpet mat, lizard mat, snake mat，chamelon mat, turtle mat, rabbit mat, bearded dragon mat, reptile supplies bedding, pet terrarium liner.
Easily cutting to fit different shapes and sizes of containers. Easy to change, easy to clean, Friendly to your plant and pet.
